target.title: fix(repair): block stale authoritative mutations
target.body:
Stacked on https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/557.

## Final Head

`2983a5f38f24c800ad38d3fb9b72b118a03e1c29`

## What Problem This Solves

Authoritative repair mutations could cross the GitHub request boundary after the reviewed target, covering pull request, or required-check state had changed. Long-running workers could also reach deferred publication with expired state credentials.

## Exact-Review P1 Fixes

1. Target freshness now rereads target activity after the potentially paginated review cursor scan. Owned mutation acceptance advances its baseline only after the same post-review target reread.
2. Coverage-based duplicate and superseded closes carry the covering PR authorization snapshot into the final one-shot mutation boundary, so covering-PR drift after proof blocks immediately before close.
3. Apply-result and post-flight merge requests bind the exact required-check rollup immediately before the request, including the second guard after the attempt receipt and before the one-shot mutation.
4. The repair worker renews the state token after the 70-minute execute step and rebinds the existing state checkout credentials before deferred outcome, apply-result, post-flight, closeout, or mutation-receipt publication.

## Exact-Rereview Follow-ups

- Apply-result now classifies `--match-head-commit` merge conflicts, base drift, head drift, and not-mergeable responses as proven non-mutations, records a rejected receipt, and returns a retryable blocked result.
- Post-flight now treats a locked-conversation 403 during post-merge closeout as a terminal skipped closeout instead of aborting later closeouts.

The implementation preserves one-shot GitHub writes, fail-closed unknown outcomes, digest-only receipt privacy, existing ledger invariants, and the dependency on PR 557. `CHANGELOG.md` is unchanged.

## Validation

- Focused apply-result and post-flight regressions: 48 passed.
- Full repair suite: 783 passed.
- Full unit suite: 1,177 passed, 2 platform skips, 0 failed.
- Full coverage gate: 1,960 passed, 2 platform skips, 0 failed; 76.58% lines, 72.41% branches, 85.36% functions.
- All three TypeScript builds passed.
- Active-surface and limits checks passed.
- All configured `oxlint` surfaces passed.
- Full `oxfmt --check` surface passed: 367 files.
- `actionlint` v1.7.12 passed for `.github/workflows/repair-cluster-worker.yml`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `CHANGELOG.md` has no diff from `fix/review-activity-cursor-current`.

## Exact Review

Read-only local exact review completed against:

- PR head: `2983a5f38f24c800ad38d3fb9b72b118a03e1c29`
- reviewed base/main snapshot: `baa1a9b402aae49a819b735f851cf08f24c2fee9`
- `review_status`: `complete`
- correctness: `patch is correct`
- confidence: `0.92` / high
- review findings: none
- security review: cleared, no concerns
- decision: `keep_open` only because this is a member-authored draft stacked on open PR 557 and requires the expected maintainer rollout decision

## Hosted Checks

Required hosted checks currently passing: CodeQL, both CodeQL analyses, crawl-remote toolchain integration, and Windows Codex launcher. `pnpm check` remains in progress; the notification-only activity workflow is non-blocking.
